search_intent: Catering staff, food handlers, and storekeepers wanting a clear, authoritative visual chart explaining the statutory difference between 'Use-By' (food safety law) and 'Best-Before' (quality benchmark), along with standard shelf-life durations across chilled, frozen, and ambient pantry foods.

competitors.weaknesses: Short generic webpage, lacks structured kitchen wall poster layout and category shelf-life lookup.

competitors.title: Date Labelling Guidance | WRAP UK
competitors.strengths: Focuses on preventing unnecessary commercial food waste.
competitors.weaknesses: Technical policy guide, no interactive browser tool or printable catering day-dot checklist.

competitors.title: Use-By vs Best Before Dates Explained | High Speed Training
competitors.weaknesses: Static illustration promoting Level 2 courses, no printable catering wall chart.

competitors.title: Food Storage & Dating Chart | WebstaurantStore
competitors.weaknesses: US FDA regulations, Fahrenheit units, no UK legal framework (Regulation 1169/2014).

competitors.title: How Long Does Food Last? | Eat By Date
competitors.weaknesses: Ad-heavy consumer interface, lacks commercial catering HACCP context and audit trails.

gap_analysis.what_they_have: Basic text descriptions or domestic expiration lookups.
